tfr1_challenge4_entries.target: TfR1 P02786 - targets the His707 'groove' (interface res ~V532, F685, F701-L716, K717, K720, F731, R732, L735, A738-T743), NOT the apical tip; human/mouse identity 1.00 there vs 0.59 apical
tfr1_challenge4_entries.tools: RFdiffusion-Proteina (RFD4) with histidine-enriched conditioning; PROPKA3 Wyman linkage scorer (L<=-2 target); PDB2PQR/APBS second estimator; Rosetta InterfaceAnalyzer dG_separated guard; Foldseek/TM-align novelty vs PDB + patents; dimer occlusion + epitope charge census
tfr1_challenge4_entries.sequences_published: 25 ranked designs (56-100 aa, i_pDAE 0.21-0.46) at results/pods/c4_E1_human/3_Ranked/!_Ranked.csv; ~19 his707 variant PDBs in results/c4_traj; METHOD.md + TARGET_PREP.md fully public
lessons: Histidine contribution saturates ~-1.1 to -1.3 log units and only with free pKa 7.0-8.0 + >=2-unit depression on binding; '2-3 histidines = 2 log units' claim was wrong (-0.34 measured on smoke design)

Target carboxylates dominate the budget: a target Glu whose pKa rises into the 6-7.4 window contributed +1.26 log units and flipped the sign of a C3 design (total L=+1.20). Measure per-residue contributions, not His count
Apical sites dead for two independent reasons: 0.59 human/mouse identity; E2a has no His, E2b buries 10 carboxylates
Put Asp/Glu next to switch His on binder's own surface (raises free pKa; desolvation on binding depresses it)
Charge-compensate every buried carboxylate rather than excluding acids; size of pKa shift matters only if it crosses the 6.0-7.4 window

tfr1_challenge4_entries.team: Unknown solo (GitHub olimpijada72); planning stage, created 2026-10-27
tfr1_challenge4_entries.target: TfR1 apical domain, 20-design portfolio incl. 2 unmodified controls
tfr1_challenge4_entries.tools: Plan: RFdiffusion -> ProteinMPNN -> Boltz-2; ipSAE filter; mouse re-fold gate; His grafting via 3 routes: A manual + FoldX BuildModel + Boltz-2 refold gate + ArcRefine; B Baker lab ph_binder_paper his_ph_interface (priority); C Proton-PottsMPNN (wild card)
lessons: ipTM useless for ranking (target-dominated with 195-res target vs 75-res binder); ipSAE separates better
Binder length 65-90 aa deliberately: large interfaces cannot be broken by one protonated histidine
His next to Arg = strongest placement (Arg stays positive at both pH -> protonation creates active repulsion)
Cut to apical domain 189-383, keep one chain, strip heteroatoms/sugars before generation

tfr1_challenge4_entries.team: Talal Ahmed; Track 3; all four challenges
tfr1_challenge4_entries.target: TfR1 C4 in progress (plus C1 EGFR 5 designs, C2 TNF 20, C3 GLP-1R 20 submitted)
tfr1_challenge4_entries.tools: AF2 hallucination (AfDesign/ColabDesign), ProteinMPNN rescore, ESMFold self-consistency, independent re-prediction at 3 recycles; PROPKA 3.5.1 Wyman linkage (tfr1/pka_switch.py); Kaggle T4x2
tfr1_challenge4_entries.sequences_published: C1 EGFR sequences in repo; C2/C3 withheld pending results; C4 TfR1 sequences not yet published (in progress). Epitope choice + PKA validation docs public
lessons: TfR1 epitope: conserved shoulder of apical domain (R325/E272/A269/S327 patch, 80-86% conserved) primary; S706 patch (94% conserved) secondary; apical tip only as declared long shot (33% conserved)

PKA validation: Wyman linkage on PROPKA 3.5.1 validated on 1I1A FcRn (-0.94, correct sign), 1BRS (+0.04), 3HFM (+0.20); first attempt on 1FRT failed (+0.86) because 4.5 A structure had a His310/Glu117 clash -> never use low-res structures for pKa geometry
Adjacent histidines shift each other's pKa; space His sites apart ('two histidines are not twice one')
AF2 interface confidence anti-correlated with functional epitope engagement (GLP-1R, -0.96/-0.67/-0.80); truncated target invented a phantom binding site; TNF pH ranking metric had wrong sign (+0.24)

lessons: Crop to apical domain: ~3 min per run vs ~2 h for full 641-residue target (Apple MPS)
RFdiffusion chain numbering pitfall: binder=chain A, target chain B starts at n+1 -> hotspot analysis silently misaligned
Relaxation vs first ProteinMPNN design: marginal difference at high compute cost; CyclicMPNN did not beat ProteinMPNN in small-scale test

challenge1to3_transferable.targets: C1 EGFR (16 submitted, 11 passed novelty), C2 TNF (20, all passed), C3 GLP-1R (20, all passed)
challenge1to3_transferable.sequences_published: Yes - submission files per challenge (11 EGFR, 20 TNF, 20 GLP-1R)
lessons: Accidental CTPR homology discovered pre-submission; cutting sequence identity 30-45 points did not move the fold -> sequence vs structural novelty separable
Structural novelty must be measured on the monomer (organizers fold the submitted sequence alone): 0/693 draws high-similarity when measured correctly
Confidence axis AUROC 0.601 - not predictive; entanglement vs engagement anti-correlated; median interface ipAE 18 A
0/88 (C1) and 0/96 (C3) designs passed their own Baker-criteria predictor; submitted anyway with limitations stated

challenge1to3_transferable.targets: C1 EGFR (5 designs), C2 TNF (12 designs), C3 GLP-1R in progress; no C4 found
lessons: Selection calibrated on Adaptyv wet-lab data (N~2,600) + literature (3,766 binders): shape complementarity >=0.58 (pyrosetta Lawrence-Colman, cross-validation value decides) and Boltz ipSAE_min >=0.60
C1 pH switch placed on target His409 via binder carboxylate (Liu et al. 2022 G532 mechanism); C2 uses binder-side His vs target R32/K65 repulsion
pH selectivity and mouse cross-reactivity conflicted at a single residue - no molecule met both; predictors do not model protonation
